race.comment: GRIDLOCK (14) returned from a 14-week spell in impressive style last start, coming from next to last on the bend to take out a 1250m maiden at Newcastle. Progressive three-year-old who should relish the longer trip second-up. Good enough to go back-to-back. STAR MINERVA (11) is a very fast mare who scored on debut at massive odds over 1200m here, leading from the outset. Tried a repeat performance in a Class 2 over 1300m at Goulburn last time but found one better. Won't find this any harder and if she can control things she might be tough to catch. SUPERATA (4) came with a well-timed run to record a comfortable win over this trip at Nowra recently. Consistent gelding who is building a nice 1400m record. Should be competitive again. ME ME (9) overcame difficulties to be beaten under a length in an eye-catching performance over 1200m here last start. Watch for her in the dying stages. CRATHIE KIRK (7) will find this short of her best but might surprise while fresh.
